> :not(.ns-keep) { display: none !important; }
[data-ns="off"] > .ns-root { display: none !important; }
[data-ns] > .ns-switch { margin-bottom: 20px; }

.ns-switch { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.ns-switch-label { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted-foreground); }
.ns-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-slide); }
.ns-seg button {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 16px;
  font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.24 0.045 300 / 0.62);
  transition: background-color var(--default-transition-duration) var(--default-transition-timing-function), color var(--default-transition-duration);
}
.ns-seg button:hover { color: var(--color-foreground); }
.ns-seg button[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--color-primary); color: oklch(0.985 0.006 300); box-shadow: 0 2px 10px oklch(0.44 0.16 300 / 0.25); }
.ns-new { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-impulse); color: var(--color-impulse-ink); }

/* stage */
.ns-stage {
  position: relative; margin-inline: auto; width: 100%; max-width: 560px; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 28px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 62% 54% at 50% 46%, oklch(0.985 0.012 300) 0%, oklch(0.95 0.03 305) 58%, oklch(0.86 0.05 305) 84%, var(--color-eyepiece) 128%);
  background-color: var(--color-eyepiece);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.24 0.045 300 / 0.06);
}
.ns-canvas { position: absolute; inset: 0; cursor: grab; }
.ns-canvas:active { cursor: grabbing; }
.ns-labels { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; }
.ns-label { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; transition: opacity 220ms ease; will-change: transform; }
.ns-badge {
  position: absolute; top: 16px; inset-inline-start: 16px; pointer-events: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 12px;
  background: oklch(0.2 0.04 300 / 0.7); color: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.86); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 14px;
}
.ns-legend {
  position: absolute; bottom: 14px; inset-inline: 14px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 4px 12px; pointer-events: none;
  font-size: 14px; color: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.86);
}
.ns-legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.2 0.04 300 / 0.55); }
.ns-legend i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; display: inline-block; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.5); }
.ns-loading { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--font-display); color: var(--muted-foreground); }

.ns-tools { margin: 12px auto 0; max-width: 560px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; }
.ns-tools .ns-pressed { background: var(--color-primary); color: oklch(0.985 0.006 300); border-color: transparent; }

/* reflex steps */
.ns-steps {
  position: absolute; inset-inline: 14px; top: 56px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 20px;
  background: oklch(0.2 0.04 300 / 0.86); color: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.94); backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  animation: ns-rise 320ms var(--default-transition-timing-function);
}
.ns-steps-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
.ns-steps-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-impulse); }
.ns-steps-dots { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.ns-steps-dots i { width: 18px; height: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.18); transition: background-color 200ms; }
.ns-steps-dots i.done { background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.55); }
.ns-steps-dots i.on { background: var(--color-impulse); }
.ns-steps-now { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 8px; animation: ns-fade 260ms ease; }
.ns-steps-now b { flex: none; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 999px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--color-impulse); color: var(--color-impulse-ink); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 15px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px oklch(0.82 0.16 80 / 0.3); }
.ns-steps-now span { flex: 1; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; }
.ns-steps-now em { font-style: normal; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.12); }
.ns-steps-foot { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.65); }
.ns-en { margin-top: 2px; direction: ltr; text-align: end; }

/* quiz bar */
.ns-quizbar {
  position: absolute; top: 56px; inset-inline: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 20px;
  background: oklch(0.985 0.006 300 / 0.92); box-shadow: 0 6px 24px oklch(0.2 0.04 300 / 0.18); animation: ns-rise 260ms var(--default-transition-timing-function);
}
.ns-q-count { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted-foreground); }
.ns-q-ask { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 20px; flex: 1; }
.ns-q-ask b { color: var(--color-primary); }
.ns-q-fb { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; }
.ns-q-fb:empty { display: none; }
.ns-q-fb.ok { background: oklch(0.56 0.13 155 / 0.14); color: var(--color-correct); }
.ns-q-fb.no { background: oklch(0.57 0.19 25 / 0.12); color: var(--color-wrong); }
.ns-q-final { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; }
.ns-q-final b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 26px; color: var(--color-primary); }
.ns-dots { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 16px; }
.ns-dots i { width: 28px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.24 0.045 300 / 0.12); }
.ns-dots i.done { background: var(--color-primary); }
.ns-dots i.now { background: var(--color-impulse); }

/* side */
.ns-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; }
.ns-divs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 4px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 22px; background: var(--color-slide); }
.ns-divs button {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 10px 6px 8px; border-radius: 16px;
  font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; color: oklch(0.24 0.045 300 / 0.7);
  transition: background-color var(--default-transition-duration) var(--default-transition-timing-function), color var(--default-transition-duration);
}
.ns-divs button i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.ns-divs button small { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.7; }
.ns-divs button:hover { color: var(--color-foreground); background: oklch(0.44 0.16 300 / 0.06); }
.ns-divs button[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--color-background); color: var(--color-foreground); box-shadow: 0 2px 10px oklch(0.36 0.12 300 / 0.12); }

.ns-lobes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; margin-top: -8px; padding-inline-start: 12px; border-inline-start: 2px solid oklch(0.44 0.16 300 / 0.18); }
.ns-lobes button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 14px; background: var(--color-background); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.24 0.045 300 / 0.1); }
.ns-lobes button i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; }
.ns-lobes button.on { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-primary); font-weight: 600; }

.ns-card { animation: ns-fade 300ms var(--default-transition-timing-function); }
.ns-facts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 14px; }
.ns-facts span { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.44 0.16 300 / 0.1); color: var(--color-primary); }

.ns-sub { margin-top: 16px; }
.ns-subhead { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; }
.ns-cranial { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }
.ns-cranial button {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--color-background); text-align: start; font-size: 14px; transition: box-shadow 160ms;
}
.ns-cranial button:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.44 0.16 300 / 0.3); }
.ns-cranial button.on { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-impulse); background: oklch(0.82 0.16 80 / 0.14); }
.ns-cranial b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-primary); text-align: center; }
.ns-cranial em { font-style: normal; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; }
.ns-cranial em.t-s { background: oklch(0.7 0.13 350 / 0.16); color: oklch(0.45 0.13 350); }
.ns-cranial em.t-m { background: oklch(0.44 0.16 300 / 0.12); color: var(--color-primary); }
.ns-cranial em.t-x { background: oklch(0.82 0.16 80 / 0.25); color: var(--color-impulse-ink); }

.ns-groups { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }
.ns-groups button { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 10px 4px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--color-background); transition: box-shadow 160ms; }
.ns-groups button b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--color-primary); }
.ns-groups button span { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted-foreground); }
.ns-groups button:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.44 0.16 300 / 0.3); }
.ns-groups button.on { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-impulse); background: oklch(0.82 0.16 80 / 0.14); }

.ns-ans { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; }
.ns-ans button { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-background); text-align: start; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; }
.ns-ans button b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 18px; }
.ns-ans button span { font-size: 14px; opacity: 0.75; }
.ns-ans button.danger b { color: oklch(0.58 0.17 40); }
.ns-ans button.rest b { color: oklch(0.5 0.1 175); }
.ns-ans button.danger.on { background: oklch(0.66 0.17 40); color: oklch(0.99 0.01 60); }
.ns-ans button.rest.on { background: oklch(0.55 0.1 175); color: oklch(0.99 0.01 175); }
.ns-ans button.on b { color: inherit; }
.ns-readout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; }
.ns-readout > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.985 0.006 300 / 0.6); }
.ns-readout b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 24px; color: var(--color-foreground); }
.ns-wide { width: 100%; height: 44px; font-size: 15px; }

@keyframes ns-rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
@keyframes ns-fade { from { opacity: 0.4; } to { opacity: 1; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ns-steps, .ns-quizbar, .ns-card { animation: none; } }

<style id="biofc-addon-style">
/* Independent add-on: does not change any existing laboratory styles. */
#biofc-open,#biofc-modal{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans Arabic","Readex Pro",Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;direction:rtl}
#biofc-open{position:fixed;z-index:2147483000;bottom:22px;left:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid #aa9af1;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3f287a,#6a45c5);padding:12px 17px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px #24144c55;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;max-width:calc(100vw - 38px)}
#biofc-open:hover{filter:brightness(1.07)}#biofc-open:focus-visible,#biofc-modal button:focus-visible,#biofc-modal select:focus-visible,#biofc-card:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f3bb43;outline-offset:3px}
#biofc-modal[hidden]{display:none!important}
#biofc-modal{position:fixed;z-index:2147483100;inset:0;background:rgba(15,12,32,.75);backdrop-filter:blur(5px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px;color:#241d3b}
#biofc-modal *,#biofc-modal *::before,#biofc-modal *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
#biofc-modal .biofc-panel{width:min(680px,100%);max-height:calc(100dvh - 28px);overflow:auto;background:#faf9ff;border-radius:24px;border:1px solid #ede7ff;box-shadow:0 18px 80px #08061677;padding:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:13px}
#biofc-modal .biofc-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
#biofc-modal .biofc-hgroup{display:grid;gap:2px}
#biofc-modal .biofc-tag{font-size:12px;color:#6c588c;font-weight:700}
#biofc-modal h2{font-size:24px;line-height:1.4;margin:0;font-weight:800;color:#352068}
#biofc-modal button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,border-color .15s,transform .15s}
#biofc-close{width:39px;height:39px;border:1px solid #d6cdeb;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:#59487c;font-size:24px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0}
#biofc-modal .biofc-stats{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:13px;color:#6e6282;font-weight:700;flex-wrap:wrap}
#biofc-modal .biofc-track{height:7px;background:#e4def0;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}
#biofc-modal .biofc-track-fill{height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4d329a,#4cba9a);transition:width .2s;border-radius:12px}
#biofc-modal .biofc-filterrow{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
#biofc-modal select{font:inherit;color:#39265b;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d8cdea;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;min-width:180px;flex:1;max-width:100%;cursor:pointer}
#biofc-modal .biofc-action{border:1px solid #dbd4e8;background:#fff;color:#473469;font-weight:700;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 13px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
#biofc-modal .biofc-action[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#e5dcfa;border-color:#8d6dd1}
#biofc-modal .biofc-caption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:750;color:#5d4b7b}
#biofc-modal .biofc-flipscene{perspective:1400px;height:clamp(260px,42vh,365px)}
#biofc-card{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;cursor:pointer;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .42s ease;border:0;background:transparent;padding:0;border-radius:20px;display:block;text-align:center}
#biofc-card.biofc-flipped{transform:rotateY(180deg)}
#biofc-modal .biofc-face{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:15px;overflow:auto;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;border-radius:20px;padding:26px 21px;box-shadow:0 9px 25px #3a28621a;border:1px solid #e7defa}
#biofc-modal .biofc-front{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#fff 12%,#f1eaff)}
#biofc-modal .biofc-back{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#fff 10%,#e7faf2);transform:rotateY(180deg);border-color:#b8e3cf}
#biofc-modal .biofc-face-label{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#7856a5;flex-shrink:0}
#biofc-modal .biofc-text{font-size:clamp(17px,2.6vw,23px);line-height:1.8;font-weight:750;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#261c39;max-width:100%}
#biofc-modal .biofc-back .biofc-face-label{color:#16845a}
#biofc-modal .biofc-extra{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:#456354;white-space:pre-wrap;max-width:100%}
#biofc-modal .biofc-hint{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#807294;margin-top:auto;flex-shrink:0}
#biofc-modal .biofc-buttons{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:stretch;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
#biofc-modal .biofc-nav{flex:1;min-width:105px;max-width:170px;border:1px solid #d5c9e9;background:#fff;color:#402870;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;font-weight:800;font-size:14px}
#biofc-modal .biofc-again{border:1px solid #e9c9b9;background:#fff0e8;color:#9c4d24}
#biofc-modal .biofc-known{border:1px solid #a1d7bc;background:#e4f7eb;color:#167647}
#biofc-modal .biofc-empty{display:none;min-height:170px;text-align:center;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#5d5074;line-height:1.7;font-weight:700;padding:20px}
#biofc-modal .biofc-footnote{font-size:12px;color:#82778d;text-align:center}
@media(max-width:520px){#biofc-open{bottom:16px;left:14px;padding:10px 13px;font-size:14px}#biofc-modal{padding:8px}#biofc-modal .biofc-panel{max-height:calc(100dvh - 16px);padding:15px;border-radius:18px;gap:10px}#biofc-modal h2{font-size:20px}#biofc-modal .biofc-flipscene{height:clamp(245px,40vh,350px)}#biofc-modal .biofc-face{padding:19px 14px}#biofc-modal .biofc-text{font-size:18px}#biofc-modal .biofc-nav{min-width:90px;padding:10px 9px;font-size:13px}#biofc-modal .biofc-filterrow{gap:6px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#biofc-modal #biofc-card{transition:none}}
</style>

  <div class="biofc-filterrow"><select id="biofc-topic" aria-label="اختر موضوع البطاقات"><option value="all">جميع المواضيع</option><option value="parts">مكوّنات الجهاز العصبي</option><option value="divisions">أقسام الجهاز العصبي</option><option value="physio">فسلجة الجهاز العصبي</option><option value="disease">أمراض الجهاز العصبي</option></select><button id="biofc-weak" class="biofc-action" type="button" aria-pressed="false">التي تحتاج مراجعة</button><button id="biofc-shuffle" class="biofc-action" type="button">خلط البطاقات</button></div>
  <div class="biofc-caption"><span id="biofc-topiclabel">...</span><span id="biofc-index">...</span></div>

  <div class="biofc-empty" id="biofc-empty">ممتاز! ماكو بطاقات متبقية بهالتصفية. تگدر ترجع لكل البطاقات.</div>
  <div class="biofc-buttons"><button id="biofc-previous" type="button" class="biofc-nav">السابق</button><button id="biofc-repeat" type="button" class="biofc-nav biofc-again">أحتاج أراجعها</button><button id="biofc-mastered" type="button" class="biofc-nav biofc-known">أعرفها ✓</button><button id="biofc-next" type="button" class="biofc-nav">التالي</button></div>

يسيطر على مركز الحواس والحركات الارادية ومختلف الفعاليات العضلية والانفعالات النفسية. 2. المخيخ: يقع اسفل القسم الخلفي للمخ ويتكون من قسمين، وظيفته تنظيم حركة العضلات الارادية في الجسم. 3. النخاع اللاإرادية.","explain":""},{"id":"m19","topic":"divisions","q":"اكبر جزء في الدماغ ويتكون من نصفين يفصل بينهما شق عميق:","a":"المخ","explain":"المخ اكبر جزء في الدماغ وسطحه كافة وهي اما حسية او حركية 2. الاعصاب القحفية: عددها 12 زوجا من الاعصاب الحسية والحركية والمختلطة.","explain":""},{"id":"m39","topic":"divisions","q":"عرف الاعصاب الشوكية.","a":"ألياف عصبية حسية والتعرق.","explain":""},{"id":"m45","topic":"divisions","q":"عدد مكونات الجهاز العصبي الذاتي مع توضيح لكل منها.","a":"1. الجهاز العصبي الودي (العطوف او السمبثاوي): اعصاب دقيقة تتفرع من جانبي القسم السفلي للحبل الشوكي، وظيفته عكس عمل الودي مثل تقليل ضربات القلب.","explain":""},{"id":"m46","topic":"divisions","q":"الجهاز العصبي جار الودي (الباراسمبثاوي) يتفرع من:","a":"بعض اجزاء الدماغ وكذلك المطاطية 2. تعقيم الجروح فورا وعدم تركها مفتوحة 3. اكمال جميع جرعات اللقاح الثلاثي (الكزاز، الخناق، السعال الديكي) 4. في حالة التعرض للجروح يجب اخذ مصل ضد الكزاز والمخدرة وبعض انواع الادوية غير الموصوفة من قبل الطبيب، وتكون مؤقتة او دائمية.","explain":""},{"id":"m76","topic":"disease","q":"ما هي اعراض الكآبة وكيفية علاجه و الوقاية منه؟","a":"اعراضه: 1. الصداع والدوار 2. الشعور المستمر بالارهاق والحزن وعدم مخالطة الآخرين والميل الى الانعزال 3. عدم السيطرة على الإنفعالات كالغضب الشديد وعدم القدرة على العمل اليدوي. العلاج والوقاية: 1. مراجعة الطبيب وتناول الانعكاسي هي الاعصاب الناقلة للإيعاز العصبي والرد عليه كما في عمل المعدة.","a":"خطأ","explain":"خطأ، مثالها سحب اليد أو القدم لا إرادياً عند وخزها بإبرة أو دبوس."}];
 const labels={parts:"مكوّنات الجهاز العصبي",divisions:"أقسام الجهاز العصبي",physio:"فسلجة الجهاز العصبي",disease:"أمراض الجهاز العصبي"};
 const $=id=>document.getElementById("biofc-"+id);
 const storeKey="nervous-system-lab-flashcards-addon-v1";
 let ratings={};try{const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storeKey)||"{}");if(saved&&typeof saved==="object"&&!Array.isArray(saved)){ratings=saved}}catch(_){}
 let list=cards.map((_,i)=>i),pos=0,isFlipped=false,onlyWeak=false,shuffle=false;
 function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(storeKey,JSON.stringify(ratings))}catch(_){}}
 function rebuild(){let topic=$("topic").value;list=cards.map((_,i)=>i).filter(i=>(topic==="all"||cards[i].topic===topic)&&(!onlyWeak||ratings[cards[i].id]!=="known"));if(shuffle){for(let j=list.length-1;j>0;j--){let k=Math.floor(Math.random()*(j+1));[list[j],list[k]]=[list[k],list[j]]}}pos=Math.min(pos,Math.max(0,list.length-1));isFlipped=false;draw()}
 function draw(){const countKnown=cards.filter(c=>ratings[c.id]==="known").length;const countRated=cards.filter(c=>ratings[c.id]).length;$("stats").textContent="تم إتقان "+countKnown+" من "+cards.length+" بطاقة";$("reviewed").textContent="تمت مراجعة "+countRated+" بطاقة";$("trackfill").style.width=(100*countKnown/cards.length).toFixed(2)+"%";$("index").textContent=list.length?(pos+1)+" / "+list.length:"0 / 0";$("scene").style.display=list.length?"block":"none";$("empty").style.display=list.length?"none":"flex";for(const id of ["previous","next","mastered","repeat"]){$(id).disabled=!list.length;$(id).style.opacity=list.length?"1":".5"}
 if(!list.length){$("topiclabel").textContent="لا توجد بطاقات";return}
 const card=cards[list[pos]];$("topiclabel").textContent=labels[card.topic]||"مراجعة";$("question").textContent=card.q;$("answer").textContent=card.a;$("explain").textContent=card.explain&&card.explain!==card.a?card.explain:"";$("explain").style.display=$("explain").textContent?"block":"none";$("card").classList.toggle("biofc-flipped",isFlipped);$("card").setAttribute("aria-label",isFlipped?"العودة إلى السؤال":"اقلب البطاقة لعرض الإجابة");}
 function navigate(delta){if(!list.length)return;pos=(pos+delta+list.length)%list.length;isFlipped=false;draw()}
 function mark(value){if(!list.length)return;ratings[cards[list[pos]].id]=value;save();if(onlyWeak&&value==="known"){rebuild()}else{navigate(1)}}
 function open(){ $("modal").hidden=false;draw();$("close").focus()}
 function close(){ $("modal").hidden=true;$("open").focus()}
 $("open").addEventListener("click",open);$("close").addEventListener("click",close);
 $("modal").addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target===$("modal"))close()});
 $("card").addEventListener("click",()=>{isFlipped=!isFlipped;draw()});
 $("previous").addEventListener("click",()=>navigate(-1));$("next").addEventListener("click",()=>navigate(1));
 $("repeat").addEventListener("click",()=>mark("again"));$("mastered").addEventListener("click",()=>mark("known"));
 $("topic").addEventListener("change",()=>{pos=0;rebuild()});
 $("weak").addEventListener("click",()=>{onlyWeak=!onlyWeak;$("weak").setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(onlyWeak));pos=0;rebuild()});
 $("shuffle").addEventListener("click",()=>{shuffle=true;pos=0;rebuild()});
 document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if($("modal").hidden||["INPUT","TEXTAREA","SELECT"].includes(document.activeElement?.tagName))return;if(e.key==="Escape"){e.preventDefault();close()}else if(e.key==="ArrowLeft"){e.preventDefault();navigate(1)}else if(e.key==="ArrowRight"){e.preventDefault();navigate(-1)}});
 let touchX=null;$("scene").addEventListener("touchstart",e=>{touchX=e.touches[0]?.clientX??null},{passive:true});$("scene").addEventListener("touchend",e=>{if(touchX===null)return;const diff=(e.changedTouches[0]?.clientX??touchX)-touchX;if(Math.abs(diff)>90)navigate(diff<0?1:-1);touchX=null},{passive:true});
 draw();
})();
</script>

<style id="biomaps-addon-style">

#biomaps-open{position:fixed;z-index:2147483000;left:20px;bottom:85px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid #98ead3;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#146d63,#118c80);padding:12px 17px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px #0a4c4655;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;max-width:calc(100vw - 38px)}
#biomaps-open:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}#biomaps-open:focus-visible,#biomaps-close:focus-visible,#biomaps-new-tab:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f3bb43;outline-offset:3px}

#biomaps-modal *{box-sizing:border-box}

#biomaps-modal .biomaps-title{font-size:17px;font-weight:800;margin:0;line-height:1.4;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#biomaps-new-tab{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:8px 12px;min-height:38px;border-radius:12px;background:#1f7c74;color:#fff;border:1px solid #3a9c93;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}#biomaps-close{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 14px;min-height:38px;border-radius:12px;background:#f6fffc;color:#104a46;border:0;font-family:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
#biomaps-frame{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:0;flex:1;border:0;background:#11172a;color-scheme:dark}
#biomaps-modal .biomaps-loading{position:absolute;top:50%;right:50%;transform:translate(50%,-50%);font-size:14px;color:#c2dadb;pointer-events:none}
@media(max-width:490px){#biomaps-open{bottom:82px;left:12px;padding:10px 13px;font-size:14px}#biomaps-modal .biomaps-head{min-height:52px}.biomaps-title{font-size:15px}}
</style>
